acceptanceCriteria: A marked, generated per-flow section lists counted records with trust labels and partial gaps, never stating a flow is verified; regenerated deterministically; pinned by tests.
body: Residual of V1-1868 (PR #1165, head 4c494e642, GH #1162). #1162 item 3 was deferred: the corpus does not render a marked per-flow section summarizing what counted (run+reviewed) test-knowledge records demonstrate.
title: docs corpus: generated per-flow 'what the tests demonstrate' section from counted test-knowledge joins
